messages:
isabel (Procure): Heads-up: QuotaLens sent a renewal with an opt-in for a dynamic pricing experiment. They want us to try a variable commit that scales rate with actual net tokens. Thinking about risks before we respond.

henry (Finance): What are the headline numbers? need to model impact vs flat commit.

isabel (Procure): Current avg ~1.05B tokens/mo. Proposal: option A = flat commit $32k/mo for 1.6B net tokens; option B = dynamic commit start $22k/mo scaling to $40k/mo if net tokens exceed 2.2B; metered still available at $0.019/1k. They promise a 10% credit if our billed net < projected.

li (EngOps): Technical Qs for vendor: how do you calculate "net tokens"? Is it after our client-side dedupe + your server dedupe? Window? do context/session tokens count? Also need sample schema for their reconciliation report so we can automate ingest.

amrita (Legal): Don't join experiments without contract protections. Require: 1) right to audit redacted reconciliation logs, 2) clear definition of "net tokens" in SOW, 3) cap on upside billing during experiment, 4) indemnity if experiment misbills >1% of monthly invoice.

billing-bot: BillingOps note: last QuotaLens invoice INV-2026-02 had a 6% variance vs our usage; ticket #1705 in progress for recon.

henry (Finance): From a modeling perspective, dynamic option could save us if traffic is spiky and average stays low. But downside is unpredictability. Isabel 1 can you ask for at least a 60-day POC with credits and a deterministic reconciliation format (parquet/json) we can pull into our pipeline?

isabel (Procure): Asked sales: "Can you define net tokens precisely (pre/post dedupe, treatment of context tokens), share sample reconciliation feed (schema + S3 path), confirm experiment rollback terms, and offer a 60-day POC with offset credits?"

quotaLens-sales (vendor): Replying: "Net tokens = post-our-dedupe and post-client-dedupe; session/context tokens count unless flagged; we can provide a daily redacted parquet feed to S3; POC: 60 days with 75% bill credit for first 30 days. Experiment rollback allowed with 15-day notice and pro-rated credit."

li (EngOps): Ok but we need the dedupe algorithm doc: window length, scope (global vs per-tenant), hashing/fuzzy thresholds. Also want ability to sample hashed token footprints so we can validate.

amrita (Legal): Add contract clause: vendor must maintain reconciliation feed for 12 months and provide quarterly reconciliations; any misbilling >1% triggers automatic credit and joint investigation. No experiment enforcements without signed amendment.

henry (Finance): I'll draft sensitivity scenarios: conservative, expected, and high-usage tail. If POC shows reconciliation within +/-5% vs our ingest sim, leaning toward dynamic commit. If variance >5%, stick to flat commit or metered.

isabel (Procure): Shared sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/quotalens-experiment (internal). Next steps: vendor to send dedupe spec + sample feed, EngOps runs simulated reconcile, Legal drafts experiment amendment. Plan to decide after 60-day POC verification.

isabel (Procure): TL;DR: QuotaLens willing to POC with credits and daily reconciliation. We need dedupe spec + hashed sample to validate. If audit + SLA + rollback terms look good, dynamic commit could be worth it; otherwise fallback to flat commit or metered.
